scripts.dev: bun run build:shared && concurrently "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api"
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:shared && bun --filter web typecheck && bun --filter api typecheck && bun run typecheck:scripts
scripts.lint: bun --filter web lint && bun --filter api lint && bun --filter shared lint && bun run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:nocache: bun --filter web lint:nocache && bun --filter api lint:nocache && bun --filter shared lint:nocache && bun run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:fix: bun --filter web lint:fix && bun --filter api lint:fix && bun --filter shared lint:fix && bun run lint:fix:scripts
scripts.test: bun run test:eslint && bun run test:scripts && bun run test:shared && bun run test:web && bun run test:api
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:eslint && bun run test:scripts && bun run test:shared && bun run test:coverage && bun run test:api:coverage
